en.headline: Hang Seng slips 128 points at the Wednesday midday close
en.dek: After two rising sessions the index closed the morning at 24,151, down 0.5 per cent, with the technology gauge back under 4,200.
body: Hong Kong stocks gave back part of two days of gains at Wednesday's midday close. The Hang Seng Index finished the morning at 24,151, down 128 points, or 0.5 per cent, RTHK reported.
The index had fallen by as much as about 210 points, touching 24,071, before the loss narrowed. Main-board turnover for the half-day was close to 51.8 billion dollars.

The technology index slipped below 4,200 to 4,184, a fall of 0.9 per cent. Among the large technology names, most were lower, with Alibaba among the steeper declines; JD.com rose nearly 1 per cent, RTHK said.

Artificial-intelligence model and biotechnology shares also softened. MiniMax fell more than 5 per cent and Zhipu nearly 3 per cent, while Innovent Biologics and WuXi Biologics were each down nearly 2 per cent. Local developers moved the other way: Sun Hung Kai Properties and Wharf Real Estate Investment both rose more than 1 per cent. Heavyweight financials were mixed.

zh.headline: 恒指半日收市跌128點 科技指數失守4200點
zh.dek: 港股連升兩日後回吐，中午報24151點，跌0.5%。科技指數半日報4184點，跌0.9%。
body: 港股周三中午回吐部分升幅。香港電台報道，恒生指數半日收市報24151點，跌128點，跌幅0.5%。
指數早段最多曾跌近210點，低見24071點，其後跌幅收窄。半日主板成交額近518億元。
科技指數失守4200點，半日報4184點，跌0.9%。大型科網股多數下跌，阿里巴巴跌幅較大；京東集團則升近1%。
人工智能大模型及生物醫藥股回軟。MINIMAX跌逾5%，智譜跌近3%，信達生物和藥明生物各跌近2%。本地地產及收租股逆市造好，新鴻基地產和九龍倉置業升逾1%。重磅金融股個別發展。
